svg.title: QwenMoE · SCALE_300M architecture
svg.desc: Decoder-only transformer, 10 blocks: masked grouped-query attention and mixture of experts; 337,458,944 parameters, 125,122,304 active per token.
svg.text: 337.5M total parameters · 125.1M active per token · decoder-only transformer
walking block 1 · chips: attention span (blue = global) over FFN (green = MoE)
and once at the end, ε = 10⁻⁶
8 routed experts; this token uses 2 (green, an example) plus the shared expert

g.text: keep top-2, renormalize to sum to 1

svg.text: training-time terms: see Training losses below
12 query heads in 4 groups of 3; each group shares one key/value head

g.text: position i attends to positions 0 … i only

svg.text: Inside every expert (routed and shared): SwiGLU feed-forward
computed only while training; inference stops at the logits. Numbered dots on the figure mark where each term reads from.
Base: configs/presets.py SCALE_300M, vocab 4,097, context 1,024. Dashed red outlines mark parts that are not in this repo's code (none in this configuration).
